    AI contribution
    The paper reports that the watch recognized the fall and automatically called 112 and alerted emergency contacts. Those alerts brought responders to the man behind the hedge. Humans provided resuscitation, defibrillation, and surgery. The watch's contribution is documented in the clinical narrative, but the time to rescue or outcome without it cannot be measured from this case. Apple's documentation describes the detection and notification sequence without disclosing the classifier or model version.

    CET: Impersonator caught using facial recognition app, probe ordered

    Independent reporting7 publications17 April 2025 Observed
    Date assessed 29 October 2026 Updated 29 October 2026
    AI’s part and evidence for Facial recognition app flags an impostor at a Karnataka entrance exam
    AI system
    Karnataka Examinations Authority QR code-based facial recognition app (CET-2025 candidate verification)
    Developer
    Karnataka Examinations Authority (The Hindu and ETV Bharat: 'developed by KEA'; no vendor named)
    Deployer
    Karnataka Examinations Authority
    AI contribution
    The app did the detecting. Staff scanned the admit card's QR code and captured the woman's photo. It flagged a mismatch with the photo on record (New Indian Express). It “revealed that she was not the genuine candidate” (The Hindu). The Hindu and the Times of India both report the forged card's contents. It carried her own photograph with the genuine candidate's hall ticket number and QR code. Comparing the card with her face would therefore not have exposed her. The flag depended on the app's match against the registered photograph. Staff then acted, but she fled before the principal was told. No arrest or sanction is attributable to the system. KEA's probe and the promised legal action were still pending in every report.
    Comparison
    a visual check of the admit card photograph against the person at the door

The hospital describes a deep-learning model that takes exercise-ECG signals at three time points plus 10 measured and 2 derived features (such as history and maximum workload), trained on nearly 1,000 exercise ECGs matched to catheterization data, accuracy about 80%, sensitivity 88%, in clinical use since May 2022; the authors' 2025 paper describes a convolutional recurrent network with three ECG slices and 12 features, AUC 0.83, sensitivity 0.89, specificity 0.60.

    The model read the exercise-ECG signals and report features. It returned a 72% probability of severe coronary narrowing, above the moderate-risk verdict of the manual reading and risk score. On that basis the cardiologist ordered angiography, which showed the 99% stenosis, and he stented it. The counterfactual rests on the treating cardiologist's statement, carried by three outlets and the hospital's release. He said the manual reading would have led to drug treatment and follow-up only. The hospital that says so also built the model. The dates of the reading and procedure are not reported. The published model's specificity of 0.60 means such flags are often false positives.

    Everything known about what the system did comes from Vohra's post. FSD (Supervised) was engaged, and the driver monitoring system registered that he had lost consciousness. The post carries a video that The American Bazaar describes as showing emergency services responding, not the pull-over itself. Tesla has published no vehicle data or statement. Its account replied with a heart and Elon Musk wrote “Glad you're ok!”. Those replies acknowledge the outcome, not the mechanism.     How a late-night conversation with Grok got me to demand the CT scan that saved my life from a ruptured appendix (December 2025)

    Independent reporting11 publications3 December 2025 Observed
    Date assessed 29 October 2026 Updated 29 October 2026
    AI’s part and evidence for Grok flags possible appendicitis in a man sent home; a scan confirms it
    AI system
    Grok (xAI conversational assistant), used in the browser, Not reported; the man said he used the browser version on his computer and that the December 2025 chat was a fresh conversation, and the shared transcript names no model.
    Developer
    xAI
    Deployer
    xAI (Grok web app)
    AI contribution
    The shared conversation shows what Grok contributed. He described constant pain for six hours, worse lying flat and eased by sitting with knees to chest, with no fever. Grok ranked perforated peptic ulcer first and early or atypical appendicitis second. It called that a pattern doctors take very seriously. It urged an ER visit that night for a CT or ultrasound. Once he said the legevakt had sent him home with Somac, it scripted a request for a senior doctor and a CT scan. He told Grok afterwards that asking for the CT got him prioritized for surgery. Whether his local physician or the hospital would have imaged him without that request is unknown. TipRanks reports from the thread that he told the doctors his sister, a nurse, had suggested the scan. The Reddit post the press quoted was drafted by Grok from his description. It says he walked back to the ER, where his later comments say the physician referred him the next day.
    Comparison

The police had only indications that she might be in the district, so the AI supplied the place and the moment. Human verification and the patrol did the rest. Whether and how soon conventional patrols would have found her is not reported.

    AI system
    AI care robot 'Kkumdori' (AI 돌봄로봇 꿈돌이), a conversational companion robot in the shape of Daejeon's mascot, with a crisis-detection algorithm linked to a 24-hour control center, Mr. Mind (미스터마인드) 4.0 model, with two-way conversation based on ChatGPT 4.0, supplied for the 2025 Daejeon program
    Developer
    Not named in the 2025 reports, which say only '해당 업체' (the company) runs the control system; the 2022 pilot robots in the same mascot form were supplied by Mr. Mind (미스터마인드) under an MOU with Daejeon (ZDNet Korea, 5 April 2022)
    Deployer
    Daejeon Metropolitan City (대전시), Daejeon-style community integrated care project, with the supplier's control center
    AI contribution
    The robot's crisis-detection algorithm recognized repeated danger words (“죽고 싶다”, “살려줘”) in conversation at 2 a.m. It sent an alert to a human control center. People did everything after that: the check-in call, the 112 report with location, the police visit, the family contact and the admission. The city's welfare director says the alert is what made the rapid dispatch and protection possible. Whether A would have come to harm that night is not established. Every account derives from the city's 13 August briefing.

Benefit marks

Depth

The number and color show the depth of a benefit.

  1. 1Depth 1. A convenience, or time or money saved.
  2. 2Depth 2. A measurable improvement in a result or ability.
  3. 3Depth 3. A lasting change, an ability restored, or a risk removed.
  4. 4Depth 4. A serious harm averted or a serious condition resolved in time.
  5. 5Depth 5. A life or livelihood preserved, or a change documented across a population.

Beneficiary

  • Circle: a person
  • Square: an organization
  • Triangle: society

Evidence

  • Solid. A court or regulator found a benefit, or researchers independently studied it.

  • Hatched. Independent reporting.

  • Outline. Claimed by the parties. Only the people or organizations involved, or sources whose independence has not been assessed, support the benefit.

The fill changes with the evidence. The depth color stays the same.
